prose: Baseten is raising about $2 billion in two tranches - one valuing it at $26 billion, the other at $30 billion - more than doubling the $13 billion valuation it reached in June after raising $1.5 billion, Bloomberg reports via sources. The article is blocked to the fetcher (HTTP 403), so the figures come from the feed's report of the piece.
highlights: Baseten raising ~$2B in two tranches at $26B and $30B valuations
More than doubles the $13B valuation from June after a $1.5B round
